## Summary

Describe the change, rationale, and motivation for this pull request.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] New archetype pack
- [ ] Visual workflow / metaphor enhancement
- [ ] Bug fix in prompt formula or layout heuristics
- [ ] Documentation or README translation update
- [ ] Tooling / validation script improvement

## Pre-submission Quality Checklist
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
- [ ] If adding an archetype, exactly 5 files are present in `skills/inkexplain/references/archetypes/<id>/`.
- [ ] Rights, attribution, and license notices are verified and accurate.
- [ ] `npm run build:docs` has been run to sync all generated markdown tables.
- [ ] `npm run check` exits with code 0 (all validation checks and tests pass).
- [ ] No new runtime or dev dependencies have been added to `package.json`.
